svg.title: design-system-mcp: an agent checks its UI against the design system
svg.desc: An agent writes app/settings/danger-zone.tsx, calls the check_ui tool and gets 8 errors and 3 warnings, each with a fix: border-[#ef4444] → border-destructive; p-[13px] → p-3; <Card.Description> → <CardDescription>; tone= → variant=; variant="danger" → variant="destructive"; <Button size="icon"> → aria-label="Delete"; <button> → <Button>; rounded-[7px] → rounded-sm; bg-gray-100 → bg-secondary; color: "#737373" → text-muted-foreground; marginTop: 6 → mt-1.5. After applying them, check_ui reports no problems.
